## 1. True Linked Data

### Data Preparation

```{r}
library(nhanesA) # to access NHANES data
library(dplyr)

# Pull demographics, field body measures, and clinical DXA scans
demo_data <- nhanes("DEMO_J")
bmx_data  <- nhanes("BMX_J") # can calc via height and weight (like "survey")
dxx_data  <- nhanes("DXX_J") # expensive to get ("administrative"/"claims")

# Clean and link the datasets
nhanes_pop <- demo_data %>%
 inner_join(bmx_data, by = "SEQN") %>%
 inner_join(dxx_data, by = "SEQN") %>%
 dplyr::select(SEQN, RIDAGEYR, RIAGENDR, INDFMPIR, BMXBMI, DXDTOPF) %>%
 # Filter for adults with valid Field BMI and valid Clinical DXA Fat %
 filter(RIDAGEYR >= 20, !is.na(BMXBMI), !is.na(DXDTOPF), !is.na(INDFMPIR)) %>%
 # Make gender a numeric dummy variable
 mutate(RIAGENDRFemale = ifelse(RIAGENDR == "Female", 1, 0)) 

N_pop <- nrow(nhanes_pop)
cat(sprintf("N = %d records.\n\n", N_pop))

# FOR SUPPLEMENT
cat("Total DEMO_J records:", nrow(demo_data), "\n")
cat("Total BMX_J records:", nrow(bmx_data), "\n")
cat("Total DXX_J records:", nrow(dxx_data), "\n")

# Merge
merged_all <- demo_data %>%
  inner_join(bmx_data, by="SEQN") %>%
  inner_join(dxx_data, by="SEQN")

cat("Records after inner join:", nrow(merged_all), "\n")

# Filter Age >= 20
adults <- merged_all %>% filter(RIDAGEYR >= 20)
cat("Records after Age >= 20 filter:", nrow(adults), "\n")

# Complete cases for model variables
analytic_sample <- adults %>% 
  dplyr::select(SEQN, RIDAGEYR, RIAGENDR, INDFMPIR, BMXBMI, DXDTOPF) %>%
  filter(!is.na(BMXBMI), !is.na(DXDTOPF), !is.na(INDFMPIR))

cat("Final complete cases (Analytic Sample):", nrow(analytic_sample), "\n")
cat("Total records dropped due to NA in target variables:", nrow(adults) - nrow(analytic_sample), "\n")
```

### Oracle Outcome Model

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
oracle_model <- lm(DXDTOPF ~ BMXBMI + I(BMXBMI^2) + RIDAGEYR + RIAGENDRFemale
                   + BMXBMI * RIDAGEYR, data = nhanes_pop)
summary(oracle_model)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(DXDTOPF ~ BMXBMI + I(BMXBMI^2) + RIDAGEYR + RIAGENDRFemale
                   + BMXBMI * RIDAGEYR, nhanes_pop)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Get diagnostic data from the Oracle model
diag_data <- data.frame(
  Fitted = fitted(oracle_model),
  Residuals = residuals(oracle_model),
  StdResiduals = rstandard(oracle_model),
  Leverage = hatvalues(oracle_model)
)

# Plot A: Residuals vs Fitted (Linearity)
p_res_fit <- ggplot(diag_data, aes(x = Fitted, y = Residuals)) +
  geom_point(shape = 19, alpha = 0.4, color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e74c3c",
             linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "black", 
              linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs. Fitted", x = "Fitted Values", y = "Residuals") +
  theme(    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Plot B: Normal Q-Q (Normality)
p_qq <- ggplot(diag_data, aes(sample = StdResiduals)) +
  stat_qq(alpha = 0.4, shape = 19, color = "#2c3e50") +
  stat_qq_line(color = "#e74c3c", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "Normal Q-Q", x = "Theoretical Quantiles", 
       y = "Standardized Residuals") +
  theme(    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Plot C: Scale-Location (Homoscedasticity)
p_scale <- ggplot(diag_data, aes(x = Fitted, 
                                 y = sqrt(abs(StdResiduals)))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "black", 
              linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "Scale-Location", x = "Fitted Values", y = expression(sqrt("|Standardized Residuals|"))) +
  theme(    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Plot D: Residuals vs Leverage (Outliers / Influence)
p_lev <- ggplot(diag_data, aes(x = Leverage, y = StdResiduals)) +
 scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "black", 
              linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e74c3c",
             linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs. Leverage", x = "Leverage", 
       y = "Standardized Residuals") +
  theme(    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Combine into a 2x2 grid
diagnostic_plot <- (p_res_fit + p_qq) / (p_scale + p_lev) +
 plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

# Save as high-res PNG
ggsave("FigureS3.pdf", plot = diagnostic_plot, width = 10, 
       height = 8, dpi = 600)
```

## 2. `fastLink` Match Probabilities

```{r}
set.seed(100723)

library(dplyr)
library(fastLink)
library(stringdist)
library(stringr)
library(clue)
library(ggplot2)

###########################################################################
### Generate Fake Matching Variables Without Corruption ###
###########################################################################
fakemv <- read.csv("fakedata.csv")
# https://community.rstudio.com/t/converting-dates-year-month-day-to-3-
# separate-columns-year-month-day/8585/4
fakemv <- fakemv %>%
 select(GivenName = "GivenName",
        Surname = "Surname",
        ZipCode = "ZipCode") %>%
 mutate(
  ZipCode = as.character(ZipCode),
  ZipCode = str_pad(
   ZipCode,
   width = 5,
   side = "left",
   pad = "0"
  )
 )

# SRS of fake matching variables data
srsfakemv <- slice_sample(fakemv, n = 18000)
write.csv(srsfakemv[1:9000, ],
          "fakemv18ksrs1.csv",
          row.names = FALSE,
          quote = FALSE)
write.csv(srsfakemv[9001:nrow(srsfakemv), ],
          "fakemv18ksrs2.csv",
          row.names = FALSE,
          quote = FALSE)

###########################################################################
### Use GeCo for corruption (trial-and-error) ###
### Prepare the corrupted identifiers data ###
###########################################################################

set.seed(2026)

parse_geco_batch <- function(file_path, id_offset = 0) {
 df <- read.csv(file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
 
 # Split into File A (org) and File B (dup) by searching for the exact suffix
 dfA <- df %>% filter(grepl("-org$", rec_id))
 dfB <- df %>% filter(grepl("-dup-", rec_id))
 
 dfA[is.na(dfA)] <- ""
 dfB[is.na(dfB)] <- ""
 
 # Numeric ID from between 'rec-' and the suffix, then apply the offset
 dfA$true_id <- as.integer(sub("^rec-([0-9]+)-org$", "\\1", dfA$rec_id)) + 
  id_offset
 dfB$true_id <- as.integer(sub("^rec-([0-9]+)-dup-.*", "\\1", dfB$rec_id)) +
  id_offset
 
 # Sort File B to match File A's true_id order
 dfB <- dfB[match(dfA$true_id, dfB$true_id), ]
 
 return(list(
  A = dfA,
  B = dfB,
  max_id = max(dfA$true_id)
 ))
}

batch1 <- parse_geco_batch("fakemv18ksrs1_corrupt.csv", id_offset = 0)
batch2 <- parse_geco_batch("fakemv18ksrs2_corrupt.csv", 
                           id_offset = batch1$max_id + 1)
dfA_full <- bind_rows(batch1$A, batch2$A)
dfB_full <- bind_rows(batch1$B, batch2$B)
N_total <- nrow(dfA_full)

# nrow(dfA_full) != nrow(dfB_full)) - check that File A and File B sizes match
# any(duplicated(dfA_full$true_id))) - check no duplicate ground-truth IDs

###########################################################################
### Run fastLink and 1:1 Matching ###
###########################################################################
invisible(capture.output({
 fl_out <- fastLink(
  dfA = dfA_full,
  dfB = dfB_full,
  varnames = c("GivenName", "Surname"),
  stringdist.match = c("GivenName", "Surname"),
  threshold.match = 1e-4,
  verbose = FALSE
 )
}))

fl_matches <- data.frame(
 inds.a = fl_out$matches$inds.a,
 inds.b = fl_out$matches$inds.b,
 posterior = fl_out$posterior
)

# Sort by highest posterior probability first
fl_matches <- fl_matches[order(fl_matches$posterior, decreasing = TRUE), ]

# Fast Greedy Assignment Loop
matched_a <- logical(N_total)
matched_b <- logical(N_total)
keep_idx <- logical(nrow(fl_matches))

a_idx <- fl_matches$inds.a
b_idx <- fl_matches$inds.b

for (i in seq_len(nrow(fl_matches))) {
 if (!matched_a[a_idx[i]] && !matched_b[b_idx[i]]) {
  keep_idx[i] <- TRUE
  matched_a[a_idx[i]] <- TRUE
  matched_b[b_idx[i]] <- TRUE
 }
}

# Get 1:1 matched pairs
mp_df <- fl_matches[keep_idx, ]

# Pad the unassigned records (below threshold)
unmatched_a <- which(!matched_a)
unmatched_b <- which(!matched_b)

if (length(unmatched_a) > 0) {
 # Randomly pair the unassigned leftovers and give them bounding zeroes
 padding_df <- data.frame(
  inds.a = unmatched_a,
  inds.b = sample(unmatched_b),
  posterior = runif(length(unmatched_a), min = 1e-7, max = 1e-5)
 )
 mp_df <- bind_rows(mp_df, padding_df)
}

# any(duplicated(mp_df$inds.a)) | any(duplicated(mp_df$inds.b)) - check 1:1

###########################################################################
### Evaluate Similarity Score and Results ###
###########################################################################

# ???
mp_df$is_true_mismatch <- dfA_full$true_id[mp_df$inds.a] != dfB_full$true_id[mp_df$inds.b]

jw_first <- 1 - stringdist(dfA_full$GivenName[mp_df$inds.a],
                           dfB_full$GivenName[mp_df$inds.b],
                           method = "jw",
                           p = 0.1)
jw_last  <- 1 - stringdist(dfA_full$Surname[mp_df$inds.a],
                           dfB_full$Surname[mp_df$inds.b],
                           method = "jw",
                           p = 0.1)
jw_zip   <- 1 - stringdist(dfA_full$ZipCode[mp_df$inds.a],
                           dfB_full$ZipCode[mp_df$inds.b],
                           method = "jw",
                           p = 0.1)

mp_df$True_String_Score <- (jw_first + jw_last + jw_zip) / 3

errors_pool <- mp_df %>% filter(is_true_mismatch == TRUE &
                                 posterior > 0.01)
corrupt_matches_pool <- mp_df %>% filter(is_true_mismatch == FALSE &
                                          True_String_Score < 0.99)
clean_matches_pool <- mp_df %>% filter(is_true_mismatch == FALSE &
                                        True_String_Score >= 0.99)

tau_fakedata <- nrow(corrupt_matches_pool) / (nrow(corrupt_matches_pool) +
                                               nrow(clean_matches_pool))
print(tau_fakedata) # true match noise rate
print(nrow(errors_pool)) # number of mismatches (need >= 996 for 50% target)

N_cohort <- 1993
target_rates <- c(0.05, 0.15, 0.30, 0.50)
linkage_posteriors_list <- list()

for (rate in target_rates) {
 n_errors <- round(N_cohort * rate)
 n_true_matches <- N_cohort - n_errors
 
 n_corrupt <- round(n_true_matches * tau_fakedata)
 n_clean <- n_true_matches - n_corrupt
 
 smp_errors <-errors_pool[sample(nrow(errors_pool), n_errors, replace = FALSE),]
 smp_corrupt  <- corrupt_matches_pool[sample(nrow(corrupt_matches_pool), 
                                             n_corrupt, replace = FALSE), ]
 smp_clean  <- clean_matches_pool[sample(nrow(clean_matches_pool), n_clean, 
                                         replace = FALSE), ]
 
 geco_sample <- rbind(smp_errors, smp_corrupt, smp_clean)
 geco_shuffled <- geco_sample[sample(nrow(geco_sample)), ]
 
 mp_df_sorted <- geco_shuffled[order(geco_shuffled$True_String_Score, 
                                     decreasing = FALSE), ]
 mp_df_sorted <- mp_df_sorted %>% rename(Z_FL = posterior)
 mp_df_sorted$Target_Rate <- factor(rate)
 
 # nrow(mp_df_sorted) != N_cohort - check if cohort size error

 realized_rate <- sum(mp_df_sorted$is_true_mismatch) / N_cohort
 # abs(realized_rate - rate) > 0.001 - check if realized rate not near target
 
 linkage_posteriors_list[[paste0("Rate_", rate)]] <- mp_df_sorted %>%
  dplyr::select(Z_FL, True_String_Score, is_true_mismatch, Target_Rate)
 
 cat(
  sprintf(
   "Target: %.2f, Mismatches: %d , Corrupted: %d , Clean: %d \n",
   rate,
   n_errors,
   n_corrupt,
   n_clean
  )
 )
}

# EMPIRICAL GECO POSTERIOR DISTRIBUTIONS
diag_df <- bind_rows(linkage_posteriors_list) %>%
  mutate(
    Match_Status = ifelse(is_true_mismatch, "Mismatch", "True Match"),
    Match_Status = factor(Match_Status, levels = c("True Match", "Mismatch")),
    Facet_Label = factor(
      paste0(as.numeric(as.character(Target_Rate)) * 100, "% Mismatch Rate"),
      levels = paste0(c(5, 15, 30, 50), "% Mismatch Rate")
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = Z_FL, fill = Match_Status)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6, color = "black", adjust = 1.5, 
               linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~Facet_Label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "True Match" = "#3498db", 
    "Mismatch"   = "#e74c3c"  
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + 
  theme_bw(base_size = 14, base_family = "sans") +
  labs(
    x = "fastLink Posterior Match Probability",
    y = "Density",
    fill = NULL 
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 20, b = 10, l = 20, unit = "pt"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(2, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", 
                                    color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
p
ggsave("Figure3.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```

## 3. Pre-Simulation Setup

```{r}
library(nhanesA)        # For fetching empirical NHANES data
set.seed(2026)

# NHANES 2017-2018 (J-Cycle) datasets
demo_data <- nhanes("DEMO_J") # Demographics (Age, Gender, Income)
bmx_data  <- nhanes("BMX_J")  # Field Body Measures (BMI)
dxx_data  <- nhanes("DXX_J")  # Clinical DXA Scans (Total Body Fat %)

nhanes_pop <- demo_data %>%
 inner_join(bmx_data, by = "SEQN") %>%
 inner_join(dxx_data, by = "SEQN") %>%
 dplyr::select(SEQN, RIDAGEYR, RIAGENDR, INDFMPIR, BMXBMI, DXDTOPF) %>%
 filter(RIDAGEYR >= 20, !is.na(BMXBMI), !is.na(DXDTOPF), 
        !is.na(INDFMPIR)) %>%
 mutate(RIAGENDRFemale = ifelse(RIAGENDR == "Female", 1, 0))

# Oracle outcome model 
oracle_model <- lm(DXDTOPF ~ BMXBMI + I(BMXBMI^2) + RIDAGEYR + 
                    RIAGENDRFemale + BMXBMI:RIDAGEYR, 
                   data = nhanes_pop)

# Oracle estimates (Ground Truth Beta Vector)
print(coef(oracle_model))
# Oracle Residual Standard Error (Sigma)
summary(oracle_model)$sigma

# Latent Mismatch model parameters and generating correlation
# Scale covariates (for numerical stability)
nhanes_pop$Age_S <- as.numeric(scale(nhanes_pop$RIDAGEYR))
nhanes_pop$Inc_S <- as.numeric(scale(nhanes_pop$INDFMPIR))

gamma_female <- 1.50   # Females have higher mismatch rates
gamma_inc    <- -1.00  # Higher income lowers mismatch rate
gamma_Z      <- -2.50  # Protective effect of fastLink probability
gamma_age    <- 0.00   # Placeholder

target_rates <- c(0.05, 0.15, 0.30, 0.50)
target_N <- nrow(nhanes_pop)
gamma_0_calibrated <- numeric(length(target_rates))

mapped_cohorts <- list()

for(i in seq_along(target_rates)) {
 rate <- target_rates[i]
 rate_name <- paste0("Rate_", rate)
 
 # adding a constant intercept does not change rank order
 logit_env <- (gamma_female * nhanes_pop$RIAGENDRFemale) + (gamma_inc * nhanes_pop$Inc_S)
 # Add noise to create a continuous ranking vector.
 copula_score <- logit_env + rnorm(target_N, mean = 0, sd = 1.5)
 # Attach scores and sort NHANES descending (Highest risk at the top)
 current_nhanes <- nhanes_pop %>%
  mutate(Logit_Env = logit_env, Copula_Score = copula_score) %>%
  arrange(desc(Copula_Score))
 # Sort part 2 GeCo data ascending (Worst matching probability at the top)
 current_geco <- linkage_posteriors_list[[rate_name]] %>%
  arrange(Z_FL)
 
 # High Score -> Low Z_FL
 mapped_df <- bind_cols(current_nhanes, current_geco) %>%
  rename(m_i_true = is_true_mismatch)
 
 # calibrate intercept g0
 obj_function <- function(g0) {
  pi_vec <- plogis(g0 + (gamma_Z * mapped_df$Z_FL) + 
                    (gamma_female * mapped_df$RIAGENDRFemale) + 
                    (gamma_inc * mapped_df$Inc_S))
  return(mean(pi_vec) - rate)
 }
 g0_opt <- uniroot(obj_function, interval = c(-15, 15))$root
 gamma_0_calibrated[i] <- g0_opt
 
 mapped_cohorts[[rate_name]] <- mapped_df
 
 cat(sprintf(" Target Rate: %.2f (Baseline Spearman's rho: %.2f)\n", 
             rate, cor(mapped_df$Copula_Score, mapped_df$Z_FL,
                       method="spearman")))
}

names(gamma_0_calibrated) <- paste0("Rate_", target_rates)

# See the dynamically calibrated intercepts for the DGP
# Multiply by -1 to align with the framework's P(m=0) parameterization
true_gamma_int <- -1 * gamma_0_calibrated

# Display the true intercepts for the 5%, 15%, 30%, and 50% cohorts
print(true_gamma_int)

# SAVE RESULTS FOR SIMULATION
save(mapped_cohorts,
     oracle_model,
     gamma_female,
     gamma_age,
     gamma_inc,
     gamma_Z,             
     gamma_0_calibrated,
     file = "part1.RData")
```

### R Script

```{r eval = FALSE}
.libPaths("~/R/hpc_libs")

library(dplyr)
library(pldamixture)

out_dir <- "sim_results"

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
 dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
array_id <- as.integer(args[1])

if (is.na(array_id) || length(array_id) == 0) {
 array_id <- 1
}
set.seed(2026 + array_id)

load("part1.RData")

# #########################################################################
# The proposed approach - Exact Version (Adj*)
# #########################################################################

adj_fun_exact <- function(X, yperm, Delta) {
 n <- nrow(X)
 
 sv_fun <- function(betahat, stdhat, gammahat) {
  muhat <- as.vector(X %*% betahat)
  hs <- as.vector(plogis(Delta %*% gammahat))
  one_minus_hs <- 1 - hs
  sumhs <- sum(one_minus_hs)
  sumhs_safe <- pmax(sumhs, 1E-300)
  w <- tcrossprod(one_minus_hs) / sumhs_safe
  diag(w) <- hs + (one_minus_hs ^ 2) / sumhs_safe
  phi <- dnorm(matrix(yperm, n, n) - matrix(muhat, n, n, byrow = TRUE), 
               sd = stdhat)
  w_phi <- w * phi
  sumphi <- rowSums(w_phi)
  return(
   list(
    muhat = muhat,
    hs = hs,
    sumhs = sumhs,
    stdhat = stdhat,
    w = w,
    phi = phi,
    w_phi = w_phi,
    sumphi = sumphi
   )
  )
 }
 
 obj_fun <- function(thetahat) {
  sv <- sv_fun(thetahat[1:ncol(X)], thetahat[(ncol(X) + 1)], thetahat[(ncol(X) + 2):(length(thetahat))])
  return(sum(-log(pmax(sv$sumphi, 1E-300))))
 }
 
 grad_fun <- function(thetahat) {
  betahat <- thetahat[1:ncol(X)]
  stdhat <- thetahat[(ncol(X) + 1)]
  gammahat <- thetahat[(ncol(X) + 2):(length(thetahat))]
  sv <- sv_fun(betahat, stdhat, gammahat)
  dbeta <- t(-1 / sv$sumphi) %*%
   ((sv$w * sv$phi * (
    matrix(yperm, n, n) -
     matrix(sv$muhat, n, n, byrow = TRUE)
   ) / stdhat ^ 2) %*% X)
  dsigma <- t(-1 / sv$sumphi) %*%
   rowSums(sv$w * sv$phi * ((
    matrix(yperm, n, n) -
     matrix(sv$muhat, n, n, byrow = TRUE)
   ) ^ 2 / stdhat ^ 3 -
    1 / stdhat))
  dw <- numeric(ncol(Delta))
  for (i in 1:ncol(Delta)) {
   dpi <- c(Delta[, i] * exp(Delta %*% gammahat) / 
             (1 + exp(Delta %*% gammahat)) ^2)
   sumdpi <- sum(-dpi)
   dpij <- outer(sv$hs, dpi, "*") + outer(dpi, sv$hs, "*")
   dwij <- (sv$sumhs * (-(outer(dpi, dpi, "+")) + dpij) -
             sumdpi * (1 - (outer(sv$hs, sv$hs, "+")) +
                        outer(sv$hs, sv$hs, "*"))) / sv$sumhs ^ 2
   diag(dwij) <- diag(dwij) + dpi
   dw[i] <- t(-1 / sv$sumphi) %*% rowSums(sv$phi * dwij)
  }
  return(c(dbeta, dsigma, dw))
 }
 
 maxiter <- 1000
 tol <- 1E-4
 iter <- 1
 betahat <- solve(crossprod(X), crossprod(X, yperm))
 gammahat <- rep(0, ncol(Delta))
 stdhat <- sqrt(sum((yperm - X %*% betahat) ^ 2) / (n - ncol(X)))
 
 sv <- sv_fun(betahat, stdhat, gammahat)
 objs <- numeric(maxiter)
 objs[iter] <- sum(-log(pmax(sv$sumphi, 1E-300)))
 
 while (iter < maxiter) {
  lhat <- sv$w_phi / pmax(sv$sumphi, 1E-300)
  
  diag_lhat <- diag(lhat)
  rowSums_lhat <- rowSums(lhat)
  colSums_lhat <- colSums(lhat)
  y_weighted <- as.vector(crossprod(lhat, yperm))
  
  betahat <- as.vector(solve(crossprod(X, colSums_lhat * X), 
                             crossprod(X, y_weighted)))
  muhat <- as.vector(X %*% betahat)
  var_term <- sum(rowSums_lhat * yperm ^ 2) - 2 * sum(muhat * y_weighted) +
   sum(colSums_lhat * muhat ^ 2)
  stdhat <- max(sqrt(var_term / sum(rowSums_lhat)), 1E-4)
  
  fn <- function(gammaval) {
   hs_tmp <- as.vector(plogis(Delta %*% gammaval))
   sumhs_tmp <- sum(1 - hs_tmp)
   w_ii <- hs_tmp + ((1 - hs_tmp) ^ 2) / pmax(sumhs_tmp, 1E-300)
   log_w_ii <- log(pmax(w_ii, 1E-300))
   log_1_minus_hs <- log(pmax(1 - hs_tmp, 1E-300))
   log_sumhs <- log(pmax(sumhs_tmp, 1E-300))
   term1 <- sum(diag_lhat * log_w_ii)
   term2 <- sum((rowSums_lhat - diag_lhat) * log_1_minus_hs)
   term3 <- sum((colSums_lhat - diag_lhat) * log_1_minus_hs)
   term4 <- sum(rowSums_lhat - diag_lhat) * log_sumhs
   return(-(term1 + term2 + term3 - term4))
  }
  gammahat <- optim(gammahat, fn, method = "BFGS")$par
  
  sv <- sv_fun(betahat, stdhat, gammahat)
  iter <- iter + 1
  objs[iter] <- sum(-log(pmax(sv$sumphi, 1E-300)))
  if (objs[iter] + tol > objs[iter - 1])
   break
 }
 
 hess <- optimHess(par = c(betahat, stdhat, gammahat),
                   fn = obj_fun,
                   gr = grad_fun)
 return(
  list(
   betahat = betahat,
   gammahat = gammahat,
   stdhat = stdhat,
   se = sqrt(diag(solve(hess))),
   objective = objs[1:iter]
  )
 )
}

# #########################################################################
# Model Wrappers
# #########################################################################

format_res <- function(meth,
                       tgt,
                       rep,
                       rlz_rate,
                       b,
                       se_b,
                       sig,
                       se_sig,
                       g_names,
                       g_vals,
                       se_g_vals,
                       r_time) {
 out <- list(
  Method = meth,
  Target_Rate = tgt,
  Replication = rep,
  Realized_Rate = rlz_rate,
  Run_Time = r_time,
  Est_BetaInt = b[1],
  Est_BetaBMI = b[2],
  Est_BetaBMI2 = b[3],
  Est_BetaAge = b[4],
  Est_BetaGender = b[5],
  Est_BetaBMIAge = b[6],
  SE_BetaInt = se_b[1],
  SE_BetaBMI = se_b[2],
  SE_BetaBMI2 = se_b[3],
  SE_BetaAge = se_b[4],
  SE_BetaGender = se_b[5],
  SE_BetaBMIAge = se_b[6],
  Est_Sigma = sig,
  SE_Sigma = se_sig
 )
 for (i in seq_along(g_names)) {
  out[[paste0("Est_Gamma_", g_names[i])]] <- g_vals[i]
  out[[paste0("SE_Gamma_", g_names[i])]] <- se_g_vals[i]
 }
 return(as.data.frame(out))
}

run_lm <- function(form, dat, name, tgt, rep, rlz_rate) {
 t0 <- Sys.time()
 mod <- do.call(lm, list(formula = form, data = dat))
 t1 <- Sys.time()
 r_time <- as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs"))
 
 b <- coef(mod)
 se_b <- summary(mod)$coefficients[, "Std. Error"]
 sig <- summary(mod)$sigma
 se_sig <- sqrt(2 * sig ^ 4 / mod$df.residual) / (2 * sig)
 format_res(
  name,
  tgt,
  rep,
  rlz_rate,
  b,
  se_b,
  sig,
  se_sig,
  character(0),
  numeric(0),
  numeric(0),
  r_time
 )
}

run_plda <- function(form,
                     dat,
                     mform,
                     mr,
                     name,
                     tgt,
                     rep,
                     rlz_rate,
                     g_names) {
 t0 <- Sys.time()
 tryCatch({
  args_list <- list(formula = form,
                    data = as.data.frame(dat),
                    mformula = mform)
  if (!is.null(mr))
   args_list$mrate <- mr
  mod <- do.call(pldamixture::fit_mixture, args_list)
  t1 <- Sys.time()
  
  b <- mod$coefficients
  sig <- sqrt(mod$dispersion)
  g <- mod$m.coefficients
  se_all <- mod$standard.errors
  se_b <- se_all[1:6]
  se_sig <- se_all[7] / (2 * sig)
  se_g <- se_all[8:length(se_all)]
  
  format_res(name,
             tgt,
             rep,
             rlz_rate,
             b,
             se_b,
             sig,
             se_sig,
             g_names,
             g,
             se_g,
             as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs")))
 }, error = function(e) {
  message(paste("Error in", name, ":", e$message))
  data.frame(
   Method = name,
   Target_Rate = tgt,
   Replication = rep,
   Realized_Rate = rlz_rate
  )
 })
}

run_adj <- function(X, y, D, name, tgt, rep, rlz_rate, g_names) {
 t0 <- Sys.time()
 tryCatch({
  mod <- adj_fun_exact(X, y, D)
  t1 <- Sys.time()
  
  b <- mod$betahat
  sig <- mod$stdhat
  g <- mod$gammahat
  se_b <- mod$se[1:6]
  se_sig <- mod$se[7]
  se_g <- mod$se[8:length(mod$se)]
  
  format_res(name,
             tgt,
             rep,
             rlz_rate,
             b,
             se_b,
             sig,
             se_sig,
             g_names,
             g,
             se_g,
             as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs")))
 }, error = function(e) {
  message(paste("Error in", name, ":", e$message))
  data.frame(
   Method = name,
   Target_Rate = tgt,
   Replication = rep,
   Realized_Rate = rlz_rate
  )
 })
}

# #########################################################################
# 1k replicate loop
# #########################################################################

n_reps_per_job <- 25
total_chunks_per_rate <- 40
target_rates <- c(0.05, 0.15, 0.30, 0.50)

rate_idx  <- floor((array_id - 1) / total_chunks_per_rate) + 1
chunk_idx <- ((array_id - 1) %% total_chunks_per_rate) + 1

rate <- target_rates[rate_idx]
rate_name <- paste0("Rate_", rate)

start_rep <- (chunk_idx - 1) * n_reps_per_job + 1
end_rep   <- chunk_idx * n_reps_per_job

form_ora  <- as.formula("DXDTOPF ~ BMXBMI + I(BMXBMI^2) + RIDAGEYR +
                        RIAGENDRFemale + BMXBMI:RIDAGEYR")
form_naiv <- as.formula("Y_perm  ~ BMXBMI + I(BMXBMI^2) + RIDAGEYR +
                        RIAGENDRFemale + BMXBMI:RIDAGEYR")

cat(
 sprintf(
  "\n Array ID: %d , Rate: %.2f , Chunk: %d (Trials %d-%d) \n",
  array_id,
  rate,
  chunk_idx,
  start_rep,
  end_rep
 )
)

smp_rate <- mapped_cohorts[[rate_name]]
n_sample <- nrow(smp_rate)
g0_dgp <- gamma_0_calibrated[[rate_name]]

smp_rate <- smp_rate %>%
 mutate(
  logit_pi = g0_dgp + (gamma_Z * Z_FL) + (gamma_female * RIAGENDRFemale) +
   (gamma_inc * Inc_S),
  pi_i = plogis(logit_pi)
 )

X_mat <- model.matrix( ~ BMXBMI + I(BMXBMI ^ 2) + RIDAGEYR +
                        RIAGENDRFemale + BMXBMI:RIDAGEYR,
                       data = smp_rate)

D_1 <- model.matrix( ~ 1, data = smp_rate)
D_2 <- model.matrix( ~ Z_FL, data = smp_rate)
D_3 <- model.matrix( ~ Z_FL + RIAGENDRFemale + Inc_S, data = smp_rate)
D_4 <- model.matrix( ~ RIAGENDRFemale + Inc_S, data = smp_rate)
D_5 <- model.matrix( ~ RIAGENDRFemale, data = smp_rate)

all_reps_results <- list()

for (rep_id in start_rep:end_rep) {
 cat(sprintf("Trial: %d \n", rep_id))
 
 smp_trial <- smp_rate
 smp_trial$Y_perm <- smp_trial$DXDTOPF
 
 smp_trial$m_i <- rbinom(n_sample, size = 1, prob = smp_trial$pi_i)
 shuffled_ix <- which(smp_trial$m_i == 1)
 
 if (length(shuffled_ix) > 1) {
  smp_trial$Y_perm[shuffled_ix] <- smp_trial$Y_perm[c(shuffled_ix[-1], shuffled_ix[1])]
 }
 rlz_rate <- mean(smp_trial$m_i)
 Y_corr <- smp_trial$Y_perm
 
 res_reps <- list()
 
 # Baselines
 res_reps[[1]] <- run_lm(form_ora, smp_trial, "Oracle", rate, rep_id,
                         rlz_rate)
 res_reps[[2]] <- run_lm(form_naiv, smp_trial, "Naive", rate, rep_id,
                         rlz_rate)
 
 # Plain Adjustments (pldamixture)
 res_reps[[3]] <- run_plda(
  form_naiv,
  smp_trial,
  as.formula("~ 1"),
  NULL,
  "Plain_1_Int",
  rate,
  rep_id,
  rlz_rate,
  c("Int")
 )
 res_reps[[4]] <- run_plda(
  form_naiv,
  smp_trial,
  as.formula("~ 1"),
  rlz_rate,
  "Plain_1c_IntConst",
  rate,
  rep_id,
  rlz_rate,
  c("Int")
 )
 res_reps[[5]] <- run_plda(
  form_naiv,
  smp_trial,
  as.formula("~ Z_FL"),
  NULL,
  "Plain_2_Z",
  rate,
  rep_id,
  rlz_rate,
  c("Int", "ZFL")
 )
 res_reps[[6]] <- run_plda(
  form_naiv,
  smp_trial,
  as.formula("~ Z_FL + RIAGENDRFemale + Inc_S"),
  NULL,
  "Plain_3_ZFemInc",
  rate,
  rep_id,
  rlz_rate,
  c("Int", "ZFL", "Female", "Inc")
 )
 res_reps[[7]] <- run_plda(
  form_naiv,
  smp_trial,
  as.formula("~ RIAGENDRFemale + Inc_S"),
  NULL,
  "Plain_4_FemInc",
  rate,
  rep_id,
  rlz_rate,
  c("Int", "Female", "Inc")
 )
 res_reps[[8]] <- run_plda(
  form_naiv,
  smp_trial,
  as.formula("~ RIAGENDRFemale"),
  NULL,
  "Plain_5_Fem",
  rate,
  rep_id,
  rlz_rate,
  c("Int", "Female")
 )
 
 # Proposed Adjustments
 res_reps[[9]]  <- run_adj(X_mat,
                           Y_corr,
                           D_1,
                           "Prop_1_Int",
                           rate,
                           rep_id,
                           rlz_rate,
                           c("Int"))
 res_reps[[10]] <- run_adj(X_mat,
                           Y_corr,
                           D_2,
                           "Prop_2_Z",
                           rate,
                           rep_id,
                           rlz_rate,
                           c("Int", "ZFL"))
 res_reps[[11]] <- run_adj(
  X_mat,
  Y_corr,
  D_3,
  "Prop_3_ZFemInc",
  rate,
  rep_id,
  rlz_rate,
  c("Int", "ZFL", "Female", "Inc")
 )
 res_reps[[12]] <- run_adj(X_mat,
                           Y_corr,
                           D_4,
                           "Prop_4_FemInc",
                           rate,
                           rep_id,
                           rlz_rate,
                           c("Int", "Female", "Inc"))
 res_reps[[13]] <- run_adj(X_mat,
                           Y_corr,
                           D_5,
                           "Prop_5_Fem",
                           rate,
                           rep_id,
                           rlz_rate,
                           c("Int", "Female"))
 
 all_reps_results[[length(all_reps_results) + 1]] <- bind_rows(res_reps)
}

results_df <- bind_rows(all_reps_results)
out_file <- file.path(out_dir,
                      sprintf("part2_results_rate%02d_chunk%02d.rds", rate_idx, chunk_idx))
saveRDS(results_df, file = out_file)
cat(sprintf(
 "Array %02d Task Complete. Results saved to '%s'.\n",
 array_id,
 out_file
))
```

## 5. Evaluation of Results

```{r results='asis'}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(ggtext)
library(ggmagnify)

load("part1.RData")
out_dir <- "sim_results"
result_files <- list.files(path = out_dir,
                           pattern = "^part2_results_rate[0-9]+_chunk[0-9]+\\.rds$",
                           full.names = TRUE)
final_sim_results <- bind_rows(lapply(result_files, readRDS))

cat(sprintf(
 "Loaded %d total simulation trials.\n",
 nrow(final_sim_results) / 13 / length(unique(final_sim_results$Target_Rate))
))

target_rates <- sort(unique(final_sim_results$Target_Rate))
true_betas <- coef(oracle_model)
true_sigma <- summary(oracle_model)$sigma
true_g_female <- -gamma_female
true_g_inc    <- -gamma_inc
true_g_Z      <- -gamma_Z

tval <- qt(0.975, df = 1987)


#### Calculate Predictor-Level RMSE Post-Hoc ###
final_sim_results_with_rmse <- list()

for (tr in unique(final_sim_results$Target_Rate)) {
 # Reconstruct X matrix for this specific cohort
 rate_name <- paste0("Rate_", tr)
 smp_rate <- mapped_cohorts[[rate_name]]
 X_mat <- model.matrix( ~ BMXBMI + I(BMXBMI ^ 2) + RIDAGEYR +
                         RIAGENDRFemale + BMXBMI:RIDAGEYR,
                        data = smp_rate)
 
 # Oracle linear predictor: X * Beta_true
 lp_true <- as.vector(X_mat %*% true_betas)
 
 # Subset trials for this rate
 df_tr <- final_sim_results %>% filter(Target_Rate == tr)
 
 # Extract estimated Betas (Trials x Parameters matrix)
 B_mat <- as.matrix(
  df_tr %>% dplyr::select(
   Est_BetaInt,
   Est_BetaBMI,
   Est_BetaBMI2,
   Est_BetaAge,
   Est_BetaGender,
   Est_BetaBMIAge
  )
 )
 
 # Compute estimated linear predictors (Trials x Observations)
 lp_est <- B_mat %*% t(X_mat)
 
 # Calculate RMSE: sqrt(mean((lp_est - lp_true)^2)) for each trial
 df_tr$Pred_RMSE <- sqrt(rowMeans(sweep(lp_est, 2, lp_true, "-") ^ 2))
 
 final_sim_results_with_rmse[[length(final_sim_results_with_rmse) + 1]] <- df_tr
}

final_sim_results <- bind_rows(final_sim_results_with_rmse)

# #########################################################################
# Realized Mismatch Rate
# #########################################################################

mismatch_data <- final_sim_results %>%
 distinct(Target_Rate, Replication, Realized_Rate) %>%
 mutate(Target_Rate_Factor = factor(Target_Rate, levels = target_rates))

mismatch_summary <- mismatch_data %>%
 group_by(Target_Rate) %>%
 summarise(
  Min = min(Realized_Rate),
  Q1 = quantile(Realized_Rate, 0.25),
  Median = median(Realized_Rate),
  Mean = mean(Realized_Rate),
  Q3 = quantile(Realized_Rate, 0.75),
  Max = max(Realized_Rate),
  .groups = 'drop'
 )

mismatch_summary %>%
 kable(
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Summary of Observed Mismatch Rates Across Trials"
 ) %>%
 kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
               full_width = FALSE)

ggplot(
 mismatch_data,
 aes(x = Target_Rate_Factor, y = Realized_Rate, fill = Target_Rate_Factor)
) +
 geom_boxplot(
  alpha = 0.8,
  outlier.color = "red",
  outlier.size = 2,
  outlier.shape = 16
 ) +
 theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
 labs(title = "Distribution of Observed Mismatch Rates", x = "Target Mismatch Rate", y = "Realized Mismatch Rate") +
 scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
 theme(legend.position = "none",
       plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))


# #########################################################################
# Metrics Across Replications (Unified for Betas, Sigma, and Gammas)
# #########################################################################

eval_df <- final_sim_results %>%
 pivot_longer(
  cols = -c(Method, Target_Rate, Replication, Realized_Rate, Run_Time),
  names_to = c(".value", "Parameter"),
  names_pattern = "^(Est|SE)_(.*)$"
 ) %>%
 filter(!is.na(Parameter))

truth_map <- data.frame(
 Parameter = c(
  "BetaInt",
  "BetaBMI",
  "BetaBMI2",
  "BetaAge",
  "BetaGender",
  "BetaBMIAge",
  "Sigma",
  "Gamma_ZFL",
  "Gamma_Female",
  "Gamma_Inc"
 ),
 Truth = c(
  true_betas["(Intercept)"],
  true_betas["BMXBMI"],
  true_betas["I(BMXBMI^2)"],
  true_betas["RIDAGEYR"],
  true_betas["RIAGENDRFemale"],
  true_betas["BMXBMI:RIDAGEYR"],
  true_sigma,
  true_g_Z,
  true_g_female,
  true_g_inc
 )
)

eval_df <- eval_df %>%
 left_join(truth_map, by = "Parameter") %>%
 mutate(
  Truth = ifelse(Parameter == "Gamma_Int", -gamma_0_calibrated[paste0("Rate_", Target_Rate)], Truth),
  Trial_Bias = Est - Truth,
  Trial_SqErr   = (Est - Truth) ^ 2,
  Trial_RB      = ifelse(Truth == 0, Est - Truth, (Est - Truth) / abs(Truth)),
  Covered       = (Truth >= (Est - tval * SE)) &
   (Truth <= (Est + tval * SE))
 )

polished_table <- eval_df %>%
 group_by(Target_Rate, Method, Parameter) %>%
 summarise(
  ConvRate  = mean(!is.na(Est) & !is.na(SE)),
  Mean_Est  = mean(Est, na.rm = TRUE),
  Mean_SE   = mean(SE, na.rm = TRUE),
  Bias   = mean(Trial_Bias, na.rm = TRUE),
  RB        = mean(Trial_RB, na.rm = TRUE),
  SD        = sd(Est, na.rm = TRUE),
  RMSE      = sqrt(mean(Trial_SqErr, na.rm = TRUE)),
  CR        = mean(Covered, na.rm = TRUE),
  Mean_Time = mean(Run_Time, na.rm = TRUE),
  .groups   = 'drop'
 )

unique_methods <- unique(polished_table$Method)
dynamic_methods <- sort(setdiff(unique_methods, c("Oracle", "Naive")))
method_levels <- c("Oracle", "Naive", dynamic_methods)

param_levels <- c(
 "BetaInt",
 "BetaBMI",
 "BetaBMI2",
 "BetaAge",
 "BetaGender",
 "BetaBMIAge",
 "Sigma",
 "Gamma_Int",
 "Gamma_ZFL",
 "Gamma_Female",
 "Gamma_Inc"
)

polished_table$Method <- factor(polished_table$Method, levels = method_levels)
polished_table$Parameter <- factor(polished_table$Parameter, levels = param_levels)

options(knitr.kable.NA = '-')

model_level <- polished_table %>%
 group_by(Target_Rate, Method) %>%
 summarise(
  ConvRate = max(ConvRate, na.rm = TRUE),
  Mean_Time = max(Mean_Time, na.rm = TRUE),
  .groups = 'drop'
 )

param_level <- polished_table %>%
 dplyr::select(Target_Rate,
               Method,
               Parameter,
               Mean_Est,
               Mean_SE,
               Bias,
               RB,
               SD,
               RMSE,
               CR) %>%
 pivot_wider(
  names_from = Parameter,
  values_from = c(Mean_Est, Mean_SE, Bias, RB, SD, RMSE, CR),
  names_glue = "{Parameter}_{.value}"
 )

wide_table <- model_level %>%
 left_join(param_level, by = c("Target_Rate", "Method"))

math_map <- c(
 "BetaInt"      = "$\\beta_{Int}$",
 "BetaBMI"      = "$\\beta_{BMI}$",
 "BetaBMI2"     = "$\\beta_{BMI^2}$",
 "BetaAge"      = "$\\beta_{Age}$",
 "BetaGender"   = "$\\beta_{Gender}$",
 "BetaBMIAge"   = "$\\beta_{BMI:Age}$",
 "Sigma"        = "$\\sigma$",
 "Gamma_Int"    = "$\\gamma_{Int}$",
 "Gamma_ZFL"    = "$\\gamma_{ZFL}$",
 "Gamma_Female" = "$\\gamma_{Female}$",
 "Gamma_Inc"    = "$\\gamma_{Inc}$"
)

for (tr in target_rates) {
 df_tr <- wide_table %>% filter(Target_Rate == tr) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Target_Rate) %>% arrange(Method)
 
 idx_oracle <- which(df_tr$Method == "Oracle")
 idx_naive  <- which(df_tr$Method == "Naive")
 idx_props  <- which(grepl("^Prop_", df_tr$Method))
 
 df_tr$Method <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", df_tr$Method)
 
 all_params <- levels(polished_table$Parameter)
 
 param_groups <- list(
  "Outcome Model Parameters (Beta Part 1)" =
   c("BetaInt", "BetaBMI", "BetaBMI2", "BetaAge"),
  "Outcome Model Parameters (Beta Part 2 and Sigma)" =
   c("BetaGender", "BetaBMIAge", "Sigma"),
  "Mismatch Model Parameters (Gamma)" =
   all_params[grep("Gamma", all_params)]
 )
 
 for (grp_name in names(param_groups)) {
  params <- param_groups[[grp_name]]
  
  col_order <- c("Method", "ConvRate", "Mean_Time")
  header_groups <- c(" " = 3)
  
  for (p in params) {
   if (grepl("Gamma", p)) {
    # Gammas (Table 6) as in original
    p_cols <- paste0(p, c("_Mean_Est", "_Mean_SE", "_RB", "_SD", "_CR"))
   } else {
    # Betas & Sigma (Table 5) - Bias, SD, RMSE
    p_cols <- paste0(p, c("_Bias", "_SD", "_RMSE"))
   }
   
   existing_cols <- intersect(p_cols, names(df_tr))
   if (length(existing_cols) > 0) {
    col_order <- c(col_order, existing_cols)
    vec <- length(existing_cols)
    names(vec) <- math_map[p]
    header_groups <- c(header_groups, vec)
   }
  }
  
  df_subset <- df_tr %>% dplyr::select(all_of(col_order))
  
  clean_names <- gsub("^.*_(Mean_Est|Mean_SE|Bias|RB|SD|RMSE|CR)$",
                      "\\1",
                      names(df_subset))
  clean_names[clean_names == "Mean_Est"] <- "Est"
  clean_names[clean_names == "Mean_SE"] <- "SE"
  clean_names[clean_names == "Bias"] <- "Abs. Bias"
  clean_names[clean_names == "RB"] <- "Rel. Bias"
  clean_names[clean_names == "SD"] <- "SD"
  clean_names[clean_names == "RMSE"] <- "RMSE"
  clean_names[clean_names == "CR"] <- "CR"
  clean_names[clean_names == "Mean_Time"] <- "Time (s)"
  
  k_tab <- kable(
   df_subset,
   format = "latex",
   booktabs = TRUE,
   digits = 3,
   col.names = clean_names,
   caption = sprintf("Target Mismatch Rate: %.2f - %s", tr, grp_name),
   escape = FALSE,
   align = "c"
  ) %>%
   kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position", "scale_down"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 10
   ) %>%
   add_header_above(header_groups, bold = TRUE, escape = FALSE) %>%
   column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
   landscape()
  
  if (length(idx_oracle) > 0)
   k_tab <- k_tab %>% row_spec(idx_oracle, background = "#e6ffe6", bold = TRUE)
  if (length(idx_naive) > 0)
   k_tab <- k_tab %>% row_spec(idx_naive, background = "#ffe6e6")
  if (length(idx_props) > 0)
   k_tab <- k_tab %>% row_spec(idx_props, bold = TRUE)
  
  cat(k_tab, "\n\\newpage\n")
 }
}
```

```{r results='asis'}
library(patchwork)

# Setup target methods and formatting
target_methods <- c("Naive", "Plain_1_Int", "Plain_3_ZFemInc", "Prop_3_ZFemInc")
method_labels <- c("Naive",
                   "Adj1 (Constant)",
                   "Adj3 (Plain Covariates)",
                   "Adj* (Proposed)")
cb_colors <- c(
 "Naive" = "#666666",
 "Adj1 (Constant)" = "#56B4E9",
 "Adj3 (Plain Covariates)" = "#E69F00",
 "Adj* (Proposed)" = "#D55E00"
)

# Prepare Predictor-Level RMSE Data
pred_rmse_df <- final_sim_results %>%
 filter(Method %in% target_methods) %>%
 group_by(Target_Rate, Method) %>%
 summarise(RMSE = mean(Pred_RMSE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
 mutate(Parameter = "Predictor")

# Prepare Coefficient-Level RMSE Data (All Betas)
beta_params <- c("BetaInt",
                 "BetaBMI",
                 "BetaBMI2",
                 "BetaAge",
                 "BetaGender",
                 "BetaBMIAge")
coef_rmse_df <- eval_df %>%
 filter(Parameter %in% beta_params, Method %in% target_methods) %>%
 group_by(Target_Rate, Method, Parameter) %>%
 summarise(
   RMSE = mean(abs(Trial_Bias), na.rm = TRUE),    
   SD = sd(abs(Trial_Bias), na.rm = TRUE),        
   .groups = 'drop'
 ) %>%
 mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = method_levels))

# Generate the RMSE Table
rmse_table_data <- bind_rows(pred_rmse_df, coef_rmse_df) %>%
 select(-any_of("SD")) %>% 
 mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = target_methods, labels = method_labels)) %>%
 pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = RMSE) %>%
 arrange(Target_Rate, Method)

# Print LaTeX Table
cat("\n\n")
rmse_table_data %>%
 kable(
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  digits = 3,
  col.names = c(
   "Mismatch Rate",
   "Method",
   "Predictor",
   "Intercept",
   "BMI",
   "BMI^2",
   "Age",
   "Gender",
   "BMI:Age"
  ),
  caption = "Trial-Level Error Results (RMSE for Predictor, MAE for Coefficients)",
  align = "llccccccc"
 ) %>%
 kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position", "scale_down")) %>%
 print()
cat("\n\n")
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=14}
# #########################################################################
# Unified 3-Row RMSE Figure (High Contrast & Line Types)
# #########################################################################
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

target_methods <- c("Plain_1_Int", "Plain_3_ZFemInc", "Prop_3_ZFemInc")
method_levels <- c("Plain_1_Int", "Plain_3_ZFemInc", "Prop_3_ZFemInc")

cb_colors <- c(
 "Plain_1_Int" = "#56B4E9",      
 "Plain_3_ZFemInc" = "#009E73",  
 "Prop_3_ZFemInc" = "#D55E00"    
)

cb_shapes <- c(
 "Plain_1_Int" = 16,     
 "Plain_3_ZFemInc" = 15, 
 "Prop_3_ZFemInc" = 18   
)

cb_linetypes <- c(
 "Plain_1_Int" = "dotted",
 "Plain_3_ZFemInc" = "dashed",
 "Prop_3_ZFemInc" = "solid"
)

legend_labels <- c(
 expression(Adj[Int]), 
 expression(Adj[Full]), 
 expression(Adj[Prop])
)

pred_rmse_df <- final_sim_results %>%
 filter(Method %in% target_methods) %>%
 group_by(Target_Rate, Method) %>%
 summarise(
    RMSE = mean(Pred_RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Pred_RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),      
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
 mutate(Parameter = "Predictor",
        Method = factor(Method, levels = method_levels))

beta_params <- c("BetaInt", "BetaBMI", "BetaBMI2", 
                 "BetaAge", "BetaGender", "BetaBMIAge", "Sigma")

coef_rmse_df <- eval_df %>%
 filter(Parameter %in% beta_params, Method %in% target_methods) %>%
 group_by(Target_Rate, Method, Parameter) %>%
 summarise(
   RMSE = mean(abs(Trial_Bias), na.rm = TRUE),    
   SD = sd(abs(Trial_Bias), na.rm = TRUE),        
   .groups = 'drop'
 ) %>%
 mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = method_levels))

plot_rmse_panel <- function(param_name, title_expr, data, is_overall = FALSE) {
  
  if (is_overall) {
    p_data <- data
    y_lab <- expression(RMSE ~ (X*hat(beta) - X*beta^"*"))
  } else {
    p_data <- data %>% filter(Parameter == param_name)
    if (param_name == "Sigma") {
      y_lab <- expression(MAE ~ (hat(sigma)))
    } else {
      y_lab <- expression(MAE ~ (hat(beta)))
    }
  }
  pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.3)
  
  p <- ggplot(p_data, aes(x = as.factor(Target_Rate), y = RMSE, 
                          color = Method, group = Method, 
                          shape = Method, linetype = Method))
  
  p <- p + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(0, RMSE - SD), ymax = RMSE + SD), 
                         width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.6,
                         linetype = "solid", position = pd, show.legend = FALSE)
  
  p <- p + geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, position = pd) +
    geom_point(size = 3.8, position = pd) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cb_colors, labels = legend_labels) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = cb_shapes, labels = legend_labels) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = cb_linetypes, labels = legend_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) round(x, 4)) + 
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    labs(title = title_expr, y = y_lab) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 1)
    )
  return(p)
}

p1 <- plot_rmse_panel("BetaInt", expression(beta[Int]), coef_rmse_df)
p2 <- plot_rmse_panel("BetaBMI", expression(beta[BMI]), coef_rmse_df)
p3 <- plot_rmse_panel("BetaBMI2", expression(beta[BMI^2]), coef_rmse_df)
p4 <- plot_rmse_panel("BetaAge", expression(beta[Age]), coef_rmse_df)
p5 <- plot_rmse_panel("BetaGender", expression(beta[Gender]), coef_rmse_df)
p6 <- plot_rmse_panel("BetaBMIAge", expression(beta[BMI:Age]), coef_rmse_df)
p7 <- plot_rmse_panel("Sigma", expression(sigma), coef_rmse_df)
p8 <- plot_rmse_panel(NULL, "Overall Predictor", pred_rmse_df, is_overall = TRUE)

p7 <- p7 + labs(x = "Target Mismatch Rate") + 
 theme(axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)))
p8 <- p8 + labs(x = "Target Mismatch Rate") + 
 theme(axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)))

# Combine via Patchwork
# A B C -> Row 1 (Betas)
# D E F -> Row 2 (Betas)
# G H H -> Row 3 (Sigma + spanning Overall Predictor)
layout_design <- "
ABC
DEF
GHH
"

combined_rmse_plot <- p1 + p2 + p3 + p4 + p5 + p6 + p7 + p8 +
 plot_layout(design = layout_design, guides = "collect") &
 theme(
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.title = element_blank(),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 18, margin = margin(r = 20)),
  legend.key.width = unit(3, "lines")
 )

ggsave("Figure4_RMSE.pdf", plot = combined_rmse_plot, 
       width = 14, height = 11, dpi = 600)
```
